experimental_design: The aim of this study was to investigate the mechanism by which BMP-2 induces beta cell dysfunction and loss of cell maturity.
factor_value: Thereafter islets were cultured for 10 days at 37 C° in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2 in 10 ml RPMI 1640, 2% human serum (HS; Lonza), and 1% P/S in the absence or presence of 50 ng/ml recombinant human BMP-2 (R&D Systems, Life Technologies).
number_of_biological_replicates: About 150 intact mouse islets per condition (N = 5) were collected and washed x3 in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
number_of_fractions: Fractions were collected every 1 min and combined into 13 final fractions based on the UV chromatogram and subsequently dried by vacuum centrifugation.
technology_type: The nanoLC was online connected to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific) operated at positive ion mode with a data-dependent acquisition.
